set.body:
Goal: establish the pure lexical boundary before scientific interpretation.

Acceptance criteria:
- A source line retains one-based line number, byte offset or equivalent location, and a bounded raw representation.
- The record ADT distinguishes samples, native event starts/ends, messages, recording boundaries, configuration, buttons, inputs, comments, blanks, unknown tokens, and malformed known records.
- Structural tokens are parsed under an explicit encoding policy; message payload handling is lossless under that policy.
- Unknown valid records are preserved rather than rejected or dropped.
- Malformed known records retain source location and all applicable diagnostics.
- Every sealed diagnostic case names source and operands and has a user-facing message.
- Hand-computable fixtures cover whitespace, CRLF/LF, BOM/encoding policy, long messages, missing tokens, and unknown records on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Implement lossless ASC source-line, record, and encoding algebra
